sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message.
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit, before any margin (cost:340010).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Could you lift your allocation to 22230 units per year?
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 19890 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months.
Please note:
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
As a matter of corporate policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns.
We have reviewed your should-cost estimate; however, our pricing reflects the specialized nature of our manufacturing.
We can increase the allocation to 23,400 units per year and adjust the price to €32.00 per unit, provided the contract term is extended to 24 months to secure capacity.
Alternatively, with a volume of 23400 pcs per year and a contract term of 24 months: €32.00 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Our Lieferzeit is 54 days.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Your on-time delivery averaged 80.7% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70410@2026Q3, sc:70410@2026Q2, sc:70410@2026Q1, sc:70410@2025Q4).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).
We noted the report "Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH allocates volumes" (news:20260822-23).
Could you lift your allocation to 22230 units per year?
Could you explain the reason behind the limit you stated?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have noted your past order prices and delivery records; they do not alter our current calculation. 

Allocation limits are strictly enforced to maintain reliable supply across our entire customer base. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We accept your proposed lead time of 56 days and offer a revised price of €31.60 per unit for the 24-month contract at 23400 units per year. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
